Orders have been issued under Section 51A of 'UAPA Act 1967’ and under Section 12A of the 'Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005' by Government implementing targeted financial sanctions related to Terrorism and Terror Financing as well as Proliferation Financing against persons and entities designated by United Nations Security Council Resolutions and the list of such designated entities is communicated by MEA from time to time. These orders and the list of individuals and entities so designated are publicly available on the website of FIU-India for wider access by all natural and legal persons. 2. In order to ensure that the sanctions are effective and the designated individuals or entities are not able to divert or utilize the targeted funds and assets, it is important that the sanctions are imposed ‘without delay’ as required in different International Conventions. As per the established conventions and practice it is clarified that ‘without delay’ in the context of all Sanctions related to Terrorism and Terror Financing as well as Proliferation Financing means preferably on the same business day but not later than 24 hours in any case.
